title: molt resleeve hides a check's error lines, and can say installed over them
objective: `molt resleeve` discards a liberator check's stderr (`lib/molt.sh:2735`), so a check's error lines never show there. An install that returns 0 then prints "installed" over them (eg `liberators/backup.sh:491-494`). Only `molt doctor` shows them. Make resleeve show a check's error lines.
